pages.notes: Step 7 of 8. 'AP' URL prefix (not AB) — first non-AB page code. Response-driven suggested-doc categories, each an H3 + an UPLOAD button, keyed to the applicant: (1) Identity Proof (2) Release of Information (ABCDM228 — the CBO/authorized-rep consent form) (3) Income/Employment-Related Documents (4) Rent/Lease/Mortgage (5) Expenses (6) Address Proof. Plus ADD OTHER DOCUMENT, ADD A PERSON. Extension SKIPS file uploads by design (content scripts cannot fill input[type=file]); the human uploads manually. Capture the category list for the chatbot 'what to upload / why this doc' guidance — do NOT autofill. Clicking Next does NOT advance the page; it raises the submit-confirmation modal (the step 7->8 gate, see APDMC-submit-modal). | Page body (verbatim): 'Here are some suggested documents to upload. Based on your responses, we suggest you upload documents from the list below or add any additional document. You can submit your Application now and upload documents later if needed. Need help? Contact the county office. Note: Proof of citizenship/immigration isn't required to submit this application, but your county may ask for it later. If you want to, you can add files under the Citizenship/Immigration/Birth Certificate document type for a specific person.' Suggested Documents intro: 'We recommend you submit these documents with your Application. If you can't upload them now, you can still submit this Application without them.'

pages.notes: Blocking MODAL raised by APDMC Next (no X/close control; dismiss only via the back-button). Body: 'We recommend you upload as many documents as you can. It could help to process your application more quickly. If you don't have all your documents, you can still submit your application.' Buttons: [UPLOAD MORE DOCUMENTS] = <button>, SAFE back-action -> closes modal, returns to APDMC doc list. ['Continue to submit'] = A#skip.cursor-pointer (href='javascript:;') = THE SUBMIT GATE. *** A#skip IS the extension's HARD-STOP boundary: the autofill driver must reach this modal and then HAND OFF to the human — it must NEVER auto-click A#skip. Record in selector-map as submitGate with neverAutoClick:true. *** Deliberately NOT crossed on the production VoteNow CBO account: crossing it risks an irreversible county-side submission to CalSAWS under VoteNow's CBO registration, and the gate's semantics are ambiguous (pre-submit Review page vs. direct submit — STEP 8 unknown). 'Probably safe' is insufficient for an irreversible production action.
